quantity: Alpha ratio - low-band to high-band energy balance - mean
definition: Ratio of summed spectral power in features.spectral_shape.alpha_low_band to that in alpha_high_band, expressed logarithmically, per STFT frame. eGeMAPS descriptor. Statistic: arithmetic mean over all frames/windows.
implementation: numpy/librosa STFT; 20*log10(E_low / E_high). CAVEAT: these are POWER sums, so the eGeMAPS definition is 10*log10 - the values are twice the intended dB. See open_questions.md Q5.
